containerInfo.title: Federico Redolfo
containerInfo.subtitle: Full Stack • QA Automation • API Testing
containerInfo.description: I build software solutions and automate tests to develop, improve and validate real-world applications, combining full-stack development, API integration and workflow automation.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.paragraph1: I am a software engineer with more than 4 years of experience, specializing in full-stack development, QA automation, and software troubleshooting.
aboutMe.paragraph2: I have worked in a variety of settings, ranging from developing and maintaining tools for Mercado Libre’s operations to creating web and e-commerce solutions as a freelancer. I currently work at Claro, where I am involved in the automation and validation of APIs and workflows for a large-scale project.
aboutMe.paragraph3: This diversity allowed me to develop a flexible approach to my work, combining technical and functional insights to find solutions. I incorporate artificial intelligence tools into my workflow to learn from and optimize processes, while always maintaining a technical perspective on the solutions I implement.

items.title: Isthar - QA Automation
items.description: Large-scale enterprise project focused on automating and validating operational workflows. I develop E2E and API tests using Cypress and Gherkin, integrating validations across interfaces, external services, and databases. I work closely with the development team to identify issues and ensure workflow stability before production.

items.title: Matcheador Platform
items.description: Internal platform used daily by Mercado Libre commercial analysts to analyze listings and compare them with competitors. It replaced Excel-based processes and centralized the management of initiatives, tasks, and results. I contributed to full-stack development, database optimization, and user experience design.

items.title: Matcheador Extension
items.description: Advanced Google Chrome extension developed to optimize product matching tasks at Mercado Libre. It dynamically reads tasks from a database and adapts its interface according to the task type, opening comparison windows between Mercado Libre and its competitors.

items.title: Consultorio CM&T
items.description: Management system developed to digitalize the operations of a trauma clinic. It centralizes patients, professionals, appointments, and medical records, and includes a self-service portal for patients. Freelance project developed from scratch and currently in production.

items.title: Court Center
items.description: Management system developed to digitalize the operations of a padel club. It centralizes court reservations, bookings, classes, and court management within a single platform. Freelance project developed from scratch and currently in production.

items.title: Pola Outfits
items.description: Development and optimization of an e-commerce store built on Tienda Nube, including catalog organization and management, store design and code customization, and continuous improvements to navigation and shopping experience. I currently provide ongoing support and contribute to the platform's evolution.

items.title: Technical Assessment
items.description: Technical assessment platform for frontend (React) and backend (Python) development candidates. Includes automated tests that provide instant feedback and backend integration for sending results via email.
